input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves Admin, User roles. It manages core business objects including user, authority, role. The platform provides capabilities for user, otp generator, otp. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage authority records, so that I can track and organize authority data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage role records, so that I can track and organize role data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
